findings.licence: NONE. GitHub API license=null; /LICENSE returns 404; README carries no licence or reuse statement; coffee.py has no header. Public visibility is not a licence; attribution in our README does not create one.
findings.data: Pickles/df.pickle and df_full.pickle (~5 MB each) hold ~6,000 scraped CoffeeReview reviews per the README — a subset of the 8,387 already ingested from coffee_reviews_parsed.csv. Not inspected: unpickling untrusted files executes arbitrary code.
findings.methods: TF-IDF + NMF topic vectors, lasso/linear/random-forest score predictors (num_to_score_RF.pickle, 12 MB), VADER sentiment, Markov review generation, Streamlit app. These are the fitted and generative paths this project set aside for the proposition lattice.
findings.code: coffee.py is a notebook export (get_ipython(), hard-coded Windows path); scraping_functions.py targets coffeereview.com, which the owner has ruled out for active crawling.

decisions.subject: Product design pivot: flavor vector space + cosine matching
decisions.decision: ADOPT docs/product/FLAVOR_VECTOR_DESIGN_V1.md. 8-dimension SCA/WCR-style flavor vector; V_pred from a physics/knowledge matrix over C0-C2 (brew, roast, variety+processing); V_user from Q5-Q10 with fixed increments; cosine similarity, bias vector dV, V_target = V_pred + a*dV; candidate library by cosine; attribution text. No training, no transformer; MLP only as an optional V_pred implementation, not planned. ARCHIVE the adaptive-question / proposition-lattice / product-inference v0-v0.2 line (docs/archive/adaptive-question-policy-20260912). CR-2 APPROVED. F19 repair APPROVED. New tables unified on the current checkpoint (83K after CR-2).

decisions.subject: Vector design: dimension count, candidate-library path, structure axes
decisions.decision: (1) 12 dimensions: the 8 SCA/WCR axes plus spice, herbal_green, woody_earthy, defect — 94/94 canonical concepts covered; defect is the negative constraint. (2) Candidate library = flavor profiles first (Target Profile Vector), then owner-named benchmark beans (classic templates such as Gesha / Kenya AA), then a user/community-entered offline library; product positioned as a scientific sensory diagnosis and flavor exploration tool, not a shopping guide; CoffeeReview coffees are never recommended items. (3) CoffeeReview Body and Acidity 1-10 editorial scores approved as the body / acidity axes (rank percentile).

(3) Literature files go to db/data/external-literature/ as <source_id>.claims.csv; ingest-external-literature.py merges them as LITERATURE_CLAIM into the unified context-statement table.
